shots.title: Replace Unix stderr redirection in map staleness git helper (#512)
shots.notes: The map command's git helper now suppresses stderr through child-process stdio options and no longer shells through `2>/dev/null` for staleness distance.

shots.title: Add map --check and commit-ready stderr regressions (#512)
shots.notes: Added a spawned CLI regression proving `map --check` and `commit-ready --json` do not leak the Windows path message from the map staleness path.

conditions.description: Full Windows validation passed, but broader test output still contains path noise from other Node exec redirections; raised as #514 and triaged into S143.9.
`slope map --check` exposed decimal sprint delta floating-point noise (`+0.5999999999999943`); raised as #513 and triaged into S143.8.

training.description: Node-executed commands should suppress stderr via child-process options, not shell redirection.
training.outcome: The map staleness path is now portable on Windows while preserving the ancestry-path git distance behavior.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/commands/map.test.ts tests/cli/commands/commit-ready.test.ts` passed: 18 tests.
`corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm prepare`, and `corepack pnpm test` passed on Windows: 229 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3626 tests passed, 25 skipped.
Branch-built `node dist/cli/index.js map --check` and `commit-ready --json` produced empty stderr for the #512 path.
`slope roadmap validate` passed with existing historical roadmap warnings after S143.8/S143.9 triage.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A good cleanup shot. The exact stderr leak is gone, and the regression now watches both commands that exposed it.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Treat Unix shell redirects inside Node command strings as a portability smell unless the command is only emitted into a POSIX script.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: Fixing the map path made the broader redirection pattern easier to see across the suite.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S143.8 can smooth the decimal sprint output, and S143.9 can quiet the broader Windows exec family before release.

bunker_locations: Unix shell redirection like `2>/dev/null` leaks Windows stderr when executed through Node on Windows.
Decimal sprint subtraction can print raw floating-point artifacts if not formatted.
yardage_book_updates: `src/cli/commands/map.ts` now suppresses stderr in its local exec helper via `stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore']`.
course_management_notes: Issue #512 should close when the PR containing S143.7 merges.
Issues #513 and #514 are triaged into S143.8 and S143.9 before the release sprint.
